loading.title: Loading…
loading.blurb: Looking for an existing vault on this device.

fresh.title: Your notes, locked to a passkey.
fresh.blurb: Everything stays on this device. The only way in is the passkey you create — no email, no password, no recovery codes.
fresh.foot: Lose every device with this passkey and the vault is unrecoverable — by design.

locked.title: Welcome back.
locked.blurb: Tap to unlock with the passkey you enrolled on this device.

unlocked.blurb: Notes UI lands in the next PR. For now this proves the WebAuthn PRF → wasm CryptoVault chain works end-to-end.
